steps.rollback: delete the empty database (no content DB impact)
revert the binding commit; Worker without the binding must keep running (statistics code is dormant)

steps.executes: wrangler d1 migrations apply STATS_DB --local first, then --remote with authorization

steps.step: source policies: ensure NO policy row or DISABLED for every source
local/dev canary of one API reader against a disposable database
first owner-authorized production canary (ACTIVATION_GATED, CANARY run, canary release)
steps.rollback: canary versions purgeable; release row remains as tombstone; policy back to DISABLED/PAUSED

rollback_boundaries: Everything lives in the dedicated database; no step reads or writes the content DB.
Before data exists, rollback = drop the dedicated database.
After data exists, schema rollback is forbidden (canonical history); only forward additive migrations; data recovery by D1 time travel.
Worker code must tolerate a missing STATS_DB binding (dormant).
forward_migration_rules: additive only: new tables/columns/indexes; never alter immutable columns
any breaking change = new schema_version + data migration plan reviewed by the owner
number space is private to migrations/statistics/ (independent of 0027–0030 in the content DB)
